title: John Handy's drinking and leaving the taxi dance
summary: John Handy brought white lightning and left for the Pig Pen.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: He told me he'd keep one bottle of whiskey and one bottle of soda water.
He used to bring a, he used to bring a, a, a, a pint of white lightning, you know, with him every night. Mm-hmm.
And he had a bad stomach. That's right.
He had also a red stomach. Yeah, he drank that. He left us and went down and played at the pig pen. He had a pig pen. He had a pig pen.
After, after old man, Piku quit. Yeah. And the left went down and played with Sadie. Yeah. With Sadie and Dave Oxley. That was a much easier job and I think he was paying more money than us. Mm-hmm.
